system.description:
You can target only ally. The target may reduce their [Hate] by -1. This skill may be used multiple times in the same Main Process.

(Hate 1): Skill Range is changed to 4 Sq. If you are equipped with a [shield] you may further subtract -1 from the target's [hate].

You are good at tactics and push-pull decisions in battle. You can divert the attention of your enemies to you, or you can draw the attention of those who are after your allies to you.
